# MutualReinforcementDynamics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A feedback mechanism where each agent's corrupt behavior increases the likelihood of neighboring agents adopting similar behavior, creating a network-wide contagion. Analogous to signal amplification in neuromorphic reservoirs, this concept informs how local interactions in TCC can lead to emergent global computational states.
